audit.why: Both layers already read [Ziggs, Ziggs, Ziggs, Skill, Ziggs, Zac, Zac] and agree row for row; the mirror's only chart change (phases[5].side and phases[6].side to Zac) is already on disk here, so the two directions match. Rows 5 and 6 to Zac is right — tank items are what let his engage survive the burst that answered it earlier.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 and the item spikes carried no cooldowns, so 'telegraphed and dodgeable' had nothing behind it.
audit.why: Let's Bounce! is 120/105/90s at 300 range and knocks up on each of four bounces; Elastic Slingshot is 21/18/15/12/9s at 300 charge range. His engage cooldown more than halves across the laning phase, which is exactly why the late rows flip to him while level 6 does not.
audit.corrected: whys[4], spikes[1].text and mid rewritten with both numbers.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two ability names are slightly wrong ('Stretching Strike' for Stretching Strikes, 'Let's Bounce' for Let's Bounce!), and three real interactions were absent: Unstable Matter deals percent max health, the passive heals him, and Hexplosive Minefield does less on repeat detonations against the same target.
audit.why: Riot kit: Unstable Matter is a flat 5s at 350 range dealing a percentage of maximum health, so armour is the wrong answer; Cell Division sheds reabsorbable chunks and revives him from bloblets, which is what Grievous Wounds is for; Stretching Strikes is 14/12.5/11/9.5/8s at 800 range and is an auto-attack reset, so the wind-up is the tell. Ziggs' own E states successive detonations on the same target deal reduced damage — the field zones a tank far harder than it hurts him.
audit.corrected: spikes[0].text, spikes[1].text, mid, whys[2], whys[4], dosFull[0].d, dosFull[2].d and dontsFull[0].d rewritten with the real names, cooldowns, the max-health rule and the diminishing-mine caveat.

audit.whatIsWrong: packet.defects: no cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere, sequencingCues 0.
audit.why: Elastic Slingshot at 21s rank 1 is the punishable cooldown — a spent or interrupted charge is the only window where stepping up is not a coin flip.
audit.corrected: dosFull[0].d and dosFull[2].d now state the 21s as the wait-for-X condition.

edits.before: Level 3 you out-range his Stretching Strike and pop his sustain blobs.
edits.after: Level 3 you out-range Stretching Strikes (14s) and pop his blobs.

edits.before: Level 6 stays with you — his Let's Bounce engage is telegraphed and dodgeable with Satchel.
edits.after: Level 6 stays yours — Let's Bounce! (120s) is slow enough to answer with Satchel.

edits.before: Zac wants to poke with Stretching Strike (Q) and sustain off his Cell Division (passive) blobs. Kill his passive blobs with Short Fuse autos or a stray Q so he can't heal back up, and zone his walk-up with Hexplosive Minefield. Poke him hard while he's low on tools — he's a slow, big target for your Bouncing Bomb.
edits.after: Zac pokes with Stretching Strikes (Q, 14s at rank 1) and sustains off Cell Division blobs. Pop the blobs with Short Fuse autos or a stray Q so he cannot heal back, buy Grievous Wounds, and zone his walk-up with Hexplosive Minefield — but repeat mine hits on the same target deal less, so it tolls him rather than walls him.

edits.before: His Let's Bounce (R) engage comes online but it's telegraphed and slow to wind up. Watch for him charging Elastic Slingshot (E) from fog — save Satchel Charge to blast yourself out of his knock-up, and keep the wave positioned so he has no easy E angle onto you.
edits.after: Let's Bounce! (120s at rank 1) comes online but it is telegraphed and slow to wind up. Watch for Elastic Slingshot (21s at rank 1) charging from fog — save Satchel Charge to blast yourself out of the knock-up, and keep the wave where he has no clean E angle onto you.

edits.before: Levels 3-6 stay in your favour: you out-range his Q, zone with mines, and out-damage his sustain. His level 6 Let's Bounce is telegraphed enough that good spacing and a held Satchel keep you safe from the engage.
edits.after: Levels 3-6 stay in your favour: you out-range Stretching Strikes, zone with mines, and out-damage his blobs. Let's Bounce! at 6 is telegraphed enough that spacing and a held Satchel (20s at rank 1) keep you safe.

edits.before: Long-range engage — interrupt the charge or punish the cooldown. Until it’s spent, every commit is a coin flip.
edits.after: Elastic Slingshot is 21s at rank 1 — interrupt the charge, or step up only once that engage is spent.

edits.before: Zac whiffs Elastic Slingshot and the lane briefly belongs to you.
edits.after: Zac whiffs Elastic Slingshot — 21s at rank 1 to punish it.

edits.before: That is Zac’s rehearsed moment — don’t audition for it.
edits.after: Unstable Matter takes max health — armour will not fix it.

notes: Both packet suspectNames are near-miss FALSE POSITIVES in spirit but real typos in fact — 'Stretching Strike' and 'Let's Bounce' are one character off the real names; both corrected. I did NOT assert anything about Elastic Slingshot's grounding flag interacting with Satchel Charge: Satchel is a self-knockback rather than a dash and Riot's text does not settle whether grounding stops it — recorded as unverified.
